title: Part IV · Section 05
subtitle: Prepositions
introEn: Choose the best answer to complete the sentence or question.

items.prompt: _______ the bad weather, we could not continue the game.
She decided to wait _______ Wednesday before making a decision.
Do you know that English is spoken _______ Canada?
In the picture, my brother is standing with his friends and he is _______ his red shirt.
The new dress which you bought really looks good _______ you.
After staying in the desert for a few weeks, I became tired _______ the same food.
